verdict.rationale: The only direct route to natural-language operation is the official MCP server at github.com/oracle/mcp. It lets an external AI agent drive OCI, but the evidence is a single probe mention with no detail on what it covers. The Select AI and Select AI Agent Framework items point to natural-language and agent features inside the database service, not natural-language control of the cloud platform. Missing for 10: a native natural-language console or CLI assistant, documentation of which OCI operations the MCP server exposes, and hands-on or independent confirmation that natural-language operation works.
